output: For the one handoff witness, partition every pair-demand route incidence by actual terminal v and equality of the selected ordered path q. The classes C_v(q) give |I_P|=Σ_v|I_v| and |I_v|=Σ_(q∈Q_v)ν_v(q); separate source-pair multiplicity σ_v(q)≤ν_v(q). Every reused path q lies in the intersection of its pair-specific sameTokenRoutingSupport sets, while its terminal belongs to the intersection of the corresponding localBuffer sets. Star centre-demand repetitions and distinct demands at one terminal are not identified. No upper fibre bound, cycle-rank charge, or closure is inferred.
